name: mindx-360
description: Read-only CRM and LMS support tool for MindX Tech Support

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @mindx-360/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGINT --kill-timeout 3000 --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @mindx-360/api" "npm run dev --workspace @mindx-360/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @mindx-360/contracts && npm run build --workspace @mindx-360/api && npm run build --workspace @mindx-360/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @mindx-360/contracts && npm run build --workspace @mindx-360/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @mindx-360/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @mindx-360/web
scripts.test: npm test --workspace @mindx-360/contracts && npm test --workspace @mindx-360/api && npm test --workspace @mindx-360/web
